prose: second question: while we're making steady progress now, is there any part of our process not in claude code that we can optimize in terms of execution time? the answer to this may be no, but: there was once a version of our prebuild steps that you set up, long gone now, that had the skill making calls to you to do each of the pre-build-that-wants-llm, like hypothesize... as individual steps... way more tokens but also way longer. so it was still not offloading anything from you, but breaking it into pieces that collectively took was also learning a way not to do it. so i guess i'm asking just 'are there any easy efficiency levers we should stop missing before we go on?' kind of eval. what do you think?
